description: This Java source file defines the VersionChangeLogs class, which generates a list of version change logs for the AnySoftKeyboard project. It includes details about each release, such as version number, release notes, and associated URLs.

classes.description: Inner class representing a single version change log entry, including version name, changes, and a URL to the web page with more details.
